brand.name: SimBet
brand.mission: Simulate the dopamine hit of gambling while providing a safe, consequence-free environment to help addicts recover, featuring realistic betting UI and subtle awareness interventions.
brand.emotional_tone: High-energy surface (urgent, high-stakes) with a supportive, calm underlayer (awareness messages).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact. Use p-2 to p-4 for odds grids (Control Room Grid). Generous spacing (p-6) only for awareness popups and fake deposit screen.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (tight gaps gap-2 or gap-4). Odds should be displayed in a dense bento or table format.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky Bottom Tab Bar for Mobile (Home, Sports, Casino, Profile) and Sticky Top Nav with User Balance.

buttons.primary: Neon green background (#22C55E), pure white text, uppercase, font-bold, no border radius (sharp edges) or very subtle rounded-sm.
buttons.odds_box: Dark surface (#0F291E), pure white text, neon green border on active/selected state, text-center, compact padding.

cards.match_card: Solid dark background, 1px border (#1F3D2D), no shadow. Dense layout containing teams, time, and 1X2 odds.
cards.awareness_toast: Soft glassmorphism, blue/calm tint, rounded-xl, drop-shadow-2xl, absolute positioned.

fake_deposit.description: Must look exactly like a real credit card input form. Use Shadcn Form/Input. NO DATA SHOULD BE SAVED OR SENT TO ANY BACKEND. Add a fake loading spinner, then a 'Success' checkmark, and update virtual balance.

animations.odds_change: Flash green for odds up, red for odds down. Use CSS transitions.
animations.crash_game: Multiplier counting up with a curved line graph (recharts). Must randomly 'CRASH' (red text) to simulate Aviator.
animations.awareness_popup: Framer motion slide up from bottom with gentle bounce. Stay on screen longer than typical toasts.

sports_banner.description: Soccer match in a packed stadium at night.

crash_game_bg.description: Rocket launch creating a vivid trail

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid Mobile-Web App interface with a Bottom Tab Bar and Top Header showing Virtual Coins (Start balance: 200).
Implement Google Social Login (mocked or real Firebase/AuthJs depending on stack) but keep user data minimal.
CRITICAL: The Fake Deposit interface must LOOK real (CC inputs, PIX options) but intercept the submit, show a fake success loader, update the virtual balance, and NEVER send CC data anywhere.
Implement 3 Game views: 1. Sports Betting (fake matches, hardcoded odds), 2. Crash/Aviator (canvas or recharts multiplier), 3. Slots Casino.
Implement Interstitial Ads and Banners. Use Google AdMob aesthetic or just placeholder DIVs marked as 'AdSpace' (Top, Bottom, and Popups after wins).

AWARENESS LAYER: Intercept the user journey periodically. If they lose or play for a long time, show a toast or modal: 'O vício em apostas tem tratamento. Ligue 188 (CVV).' with calming colors (blue/white), contrasting the dark neon betting UI.
Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
